statement: Version 1.79 adds Task Board and Merit Shop; Lavalaria is a new W5 NPC beside the segment portal in W5 town; quest unlocks task board
World 5 tasks are simple but difficult due to RNG; completing them awards merits
Tasks include distance sailing upgrading boats farming plants getting a bigger nugget and slab gaming
First Merit shop purchase should be mob respawn; max it out as soon as possible
Merit shop increases loot piles for sailing making artifacts a bit easier to get
Maxing merit to level 10 gives star talent level 300 giving 300 base stats but costs 300 star talent points which is expensive
Merit shop gives more XP for gaming sailing and divinity to progress faster
Flat 20 percent reduction to atom costs for atom collider is massive if you are at that part of the game
Merit shop gives an insane amount of Tab 4 talent points to max Elite Class talents
Merit shop has new armor boss recipes for cattle crook which will soon be a World 5 boss
Level merit shop in order: mob respawn then loot piles then atom reduction if there then base stats star talent then XP percent then talent points
Reserve at least eight merit points for when the brand new boss comes out
Buy the new world 4 merit shop extra plus three bubbles to upgrade for No Bubble Left Behind; overpowered and a must
World 5 achievements are massive ranging from skill XP to damage percent to bit gain to extra loot piles
Merit shop plus gem shop slugs plus achievements give a maximum of 30 chests in a pile
Three new secret achievements are available for World 5
Utter Disrespect: buy a sailor and instantly sell it
Sneaky Stealing: run behind the World 5 shop merchant
Broken Controller requires unlocking pouring and scoring zero points; the point controller is in gaming imports far right
New world 4 achievements for elite classes need 1 million kills or portals; plunderous mob and orb kills
The plunderous mob achievement will take longest because they do not drop by the hundreds of thousands
New map sidebar shows mob type mob drop NPC and skilling resources making the map easier to traverse
Lava gave everyone five free teleports
Talents can now be times Max for talent points instead of spamming times 25 for the 220 max talents
New limited gem shop rotation: vaulted premium hat parasite; Divinity and holy pearls; four stack hyper rebels; world 4 kill ring; seven dungeon dice; two free bottles of wits for free to play
Ram plushie giveaway winner announced as haydix
